# Mission Local fixture

Extracted from https://missionlocal.org/events/ on 2026-09-06.
Retains one publisher JSON-LD Event's factual timing, venue, coordinates, and source
link; descriptions and unrelated markup removed. This archived test event is not
a fallback live listing.

`event-api.json` contains factual fields for the same event from the public date-range API, retrieved September 6, 2026. The integration test supplies a one-event pagination envelope for this reduced fixture. Article descriptions and image payloads are omitted.
